deploy-bot: Starting deploy: service=infer-api version=2026-03-20-rc2 regions=[us-east-1, eu-west-1] window=23:00-01:00 UTC. Preflight checks enabled. :rocket:

marta: kicking off preflight smoke and SLO gating. please hold on manual approve if p95>250ms or 5xx>0.5% over 5m. tagging rollout with `release/2026-03-20-rc2`

monitoring-bot: preflight: trace ingest started -> https://observability.example.com/r/AB12C3 (shortlink)

jon: seeing a small spike in eu-west-1, p95 ~360ms, 5xx ~0.8% for the last 2m. sample: `curl -s https://eu-west-api.example.com/health | jq .latency_p95` returns 360

liam: copying alert, adding logs. Noting that us-east-1 looks fine (p95 120ms, 5xx 0.03%).

marta: ok leaving the global rollout paused. can we isolate eu-west and continue us-east? is routing ready for partial region pin?

ara: yes — we have the route policy config. command to pin: `rbctl traffic set infer-api --region eu-west-1 --version previous` (run by infra role). whoever runs should confirm with a follow-up message.

liam: running the pin now (iam:liam).

deploy-bot: Traffic policy updated: infer-api -> eu-west-1 pinned to v=2026-03-19-stable. (change_id: ch_9f2b)

monitoring-bot: eu-west-1 p95 dropped to 140ms after pin; 5xx back to 0.05% in last 1m. us-east rollout resumed at 10% traffic.

jon: logs show request timeouts from a subset of hosts deployed in eu-west. attaching minimal log snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T23:02:11Z] host=i-0a1b2c proc=infer-worker err="gRPC deadline exceeded"
[2026-03-20T23:02:12Z] host=i-0d3e4f proc=infer-worker err="out of memory, oom-kill"
```

marta: sounds like an instability in the new binary in eu-west. decision: abort eu-west canary and keep us-east canary progressing. we'll create a follow-up incident to investigate worker OOMs.

ara: noted. I'll open an incident and tag infra+ml-runtime. incident link: https://incidents.example.com/INC-2026-314 (created).

liam: adding quick rollback note to release notes draft: "eu-west canary aborted due to elevated p95 and OOMs; traffic pinned back to previous stable. us-east continuing."

marta: thanks. action items: 1) infra to investigate OOM root cause in eu-west, 2) runtime to run memprofile on rc2, 3) QA to run longer-run workload in staging. we'll reconvene in #eng-releases once we have a root cause. :white_check_mark:

jon: if eu-west stays quiet for 30m and no further regressions, we can re-run a smaller canary with extra tracing.

deploy-bot: Deploy status: us-east: rolling at 25% -> continuing; eu-west: aborted -> pinned to 2026-03-19-stable. Rollout window remains open until 01:00 UTC.

marta: closing thread for immediate ops. please post updates under the incident.
